verdict.rationale: The only startup-latency evidence is the template docs saying templates provide fully configured sandboxes with running processes, "ready to use with zero wait time for your users." That is a first-party claim about fast sandbox readiness, but it is qualitative and gives no measured cold-start figure. The Firecracker microVM mention implies lightweight VMs but documents no timing. Missing for 10: explicit documented cold-start numbers (sub-second or few-second), latency benchmarks for plain Sandbox.create(), and independent or hands-on corroboration of startup times.
